label: D2 after a rare a2->S1 transition following an unrewarded trial, late in the episode with low value
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent chose a2 and was carried rarely to S1 (97.5% of mass; never after a1, only 2.5% on a2->S2 common). It also requires the previous trial to be unrewarded (99.8% of mass), and it only appears late in episodes (none before trial 50; 90% of mass in trials 80-99). It is restricted to steps where the value head is low (all mass at value < 7.13). Without the episode-time and value conditions, precision is 0.17. All variables are observed at D2. The value condition is the agent own output, and ep_trial >= 70 alone gives a similar dev F1 of 0.66. Magnitude is largest for repeated a2 rare-S1 outcomes inside an unrewarded streak: the 2nd/3rd consecutive a2->S1R unrewarded trial reaches the max. It is weak (about 0.01-0.2) on the first such trial after rewarded trials, and sometimes small (about 0.1-0.2) on a2->S2 common D2 right after such a streak. It also fires strongly at D1-error trials (lift 76x, 10% of mass). It does not fire at D1 or GO, after rewards, or after a1 choices.
